text:
Ellie (growth): quick heads up — launch week paid plan updated. trying a midnight retarget window for cold->warm funnel. need ops on pacing and creative swap.
Jamal: send the ETA for the creative refresh assets?
Ellie (growth): assets in Figma, final versions by 21:00 PT today. main ask: 3 headlines, 2 CTAs, 1 short video (6s).
Rae: I'll queue the creative in the ad build. what's the budget cadence overnight?
Ellie (growth): starting with 30% of daily cap 23:00–03:00, then ramp to 100% at 09:00. test cap at 40cpa for first 2 hours.
Marcos: for search, recommend keeping phrase match on core brand and shifting broad to modified broad. pause high CPA keywords.
Jamal: can we autodetect when CPA > 60 for >30m and throttle?
Lina: AdOps Bot can flip budgets. tagging @AdOps Bot — run rule: if CPA > 60 for 30m AND conversions >=3 then reduce bid 15%.
AdOps Bot: rule created: midnight-cpa-throttle-2771112223. Sampling started. :gear:
Rae: for retargeting windows — we should do 7d site, 14d engaged video, and 30d demo page viewers. priority cap: 50% impression share for demo viewers.
Ellie (growth): agree. also route demo leads to webinar nurture flow first, then SDR if not engaged in 48h. need webhook for inbound lead routing.
Jamal: webhook endpoint is https://hooks.redwood.example/lead-router/prod. payload shape posted in #devex earlier.
Lina: adding a soft-redirect in GTM so tracking param UTM_campaign=launch_midnight is added before routing.
Marcos: experiment: swap hero creative at 01:30 — variant A (problem-focused) vs B (benchmark narrative). want 50/50 split for 6h then winner to 80/20.
Rae: set creative swap in the ad set: rotate every 24h but force immediate swap at 01:30 for the experiment. I'll also tag creatives :creative_a and :creative_b.
Ellie (growth): measurement: primary metric = demo signups per 1000 impressions, secondary = cost per demo. please log all impressions with creative id and audience bucket.
Jamal: can we get a quick dashboard? prefer a tiny chart with CPA by hour and creative performance.
Marcos: I'll wire a light Looker tile. expect first delta by 04:00 PT.
Lina: inbound routing note — if webinar RSVP conversion rate < 8% for demo viewers, escalate leads to SDR channel "high-touch-launch" and reduce retarget freq to 1/day.
Ellie (growth): got it. last thing: tagging legal for the new product claim in creative — @Marcos can you ping compliance?
Marcos: pinged compliance, they said minor wording tweak: replace "guaranteed" with "designed to". will update copy.
Rae: all queued. pushing builds in 10. will post ad IDs once live. :rocket:
Ellie (growth): thanks all — ping here if any firing errors. keeping this thread as single source of truth for the midnight experiment.
Rae: ad IDs: 83421A (creative_a), 83421B (creative_b). pacing rule active.
AdOps Bot: campaign "launch_midnight" live. budget pacing rules: 30% night cap, auto-throttle on CPA.
Jamal: monitoring. will report back at 04:15 PT with initial CPA snapshot.
Ellie (growth): perfect — appreciate it :raised_hands:
